Alif Laam Meem
Yeh hikmat se bhari hui kitaab ki aayatein hain
Jo un nek kirdaar logon ke liye hidaayat aur rehmat hai
Jo namaaz qaaim karte hain aur zakaat ada karte hain aur aakhirat par yaqeen rakhte hain
Yahi log apne Parwardigar ki taraf se hidaayat par hain aur yahi falaah paane waale hain

Logon mein aisa shakhs bhi hai jo muhmal baaton ko khareedta hai taake un ke zariye baghair samjhe boojhe logon ko raah-e-Khuda se gumraah kare aur aayaat-e-Ilaahiya ka mazaaq udaaye. Dar-haqeeqat aise hi logon ke liye dardnaak azaab hai

Aur jab us ke saamne aayaat-e-Ilaahiya ki tilaawat ki jaati hai to akad kar munh pher leta hai jaise us ne kuch suna hi nahin hai aur jaise us ke kaan mein behraapan hai. Aise shakhs ko dardnaak azaab ki bashaarat de dijiye
Beshak jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye un ke liye ne'maton se bhari hui Jannat hai
Woh usi mein hamesha rehne waale hain, ke yeh Khuda ka barhaq waada hai, aur woh saahib-e-izzat bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai

Usi ne aasmaanon ko baghair sutoon ke paida kiya hai, tum dekh rahe ho, aur zameen mein bade bade pahaad daal diye hain ke tum ko le kar jagah se hatne na paaye, aur har tarah ke jaanwar phaila diye hain, aur hum ne aasmaan se paani barsaaya hai aur us ke zariye zameen mein har qism ka nafees joda paida kar diya hai
Yeh Khuda ki takhleeq hai, to kaafiro! Ab tum dikhlaao ke us ke ilaawa tumhaare khudaaon ne kya paida kiya hai. Aur haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh zaalimeen khuli hui gumraahi mein mubtala hain

Aur hum ne Luqmaan ko hikmat ata ki ke Parwardigar ka shukriya ada karo, aur jo bhi shukriya ada karta hai woh apne hi faaide ke liye karta hai, aur jo kufraan-e-ne'mat karta hai use maaloom rahe ke Khuda be-niyaaz bhi hai aur qaabil-e-hamd o sana bhi hai
Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab Luqmaan ne apne farzand ko naseehat karte hue kaha ke beta! Khabardaar kisi ko Khuda ka shareek na banaana ke shirk bahut bada zulm hai

Aur hum ne insaan ko maa baap ke baare mein naseehat ki hai, ke us ki maa ne dukh par dukh seh kar use pet mein rakha hai aur us ki doodh badhaai bhi do saal mein hui hai, ke mera aur apne maa baap ka shukriya ada karo ke tum sab ki baazgasht meri hi taraf hai

Aur agar tumhaare maa baap is baat par zor dein ke kisi aisi cheez ko mera shareek banaao jis ka tumhein ilm nahin hai to khabardaar un ki itaa'at na karna, lekin duniya mein un ke saath neki ka bartaao karna, aur us ke raaste ko ikhtiyaar karna jo meri taraf mutawajjeh ho. Phir us ke baad tum sab ki baazgasht meri hi taraf hai, aur us waqt main bataaoonga ke tum log kya kar rahe the

Beta! Neki ya badi ek raai ke daane ke baraabar ho aur kisi patthar ke andar ho ya aasmaanon par ho ya zameenon ki gehraaiyon mein ho, to Khuda roz-e-qiyaamat zaroor use saamne laaega, ke woh lateef bhi hai aur baakhabar bhi hai
Beta! Namaaz qaaim karo, nekiyon ka hukm do, buraaiyon se mana karo, aur is raah mein jo museebat pade us par sabr karo, ke yeh bahut badi himmat ka kaam hai
Aur khabardaar logon ke saamne akad kar munh na phula lena, aur zameen mein ghuroor ke saath na chalna, ke Khuda akadne waale aur maghroor ko pasand nahin karta hai
Aur apni raftaar mein miyaana-ravi se kaam lena aur apni aawaaz ko dheema rakhna, ke sab se badtar aawaaz gadhe ki aawaaz hoti hai (jo bila-sabab bhonde andaaz se cheekhta rehta hai)

Kya tum logon ne nahin dekha ke Allah ne zameen o aasmaan ki tamaam cheezon ko tumhaare liye musakhkhar kar diya hai, aur tumhaare liye tamaam zaahiri aur baatini ne'maton ko mukammal kar diya hai? Aur logon mein ba'z aise bhi hain jo ilm o hidaayat aur raushan kitaab ke baghair bhi Khuda ke baare mein behas karte hain

Aur jab un se kaha jaata hai ke jo kuch Allah ne naazil kiya hai us ka ittibaa' karo to kehte hain ke hum us ka ittibaa' karte hain jis par apne baap daada ko amal karte dekha hai, chaahe Shaitaan un ko azaab-e-Jahannam ki taraf daawat de raha ho
Aur jo apna roo-e-hayaat Khuda ki taraf mod de aur woh nek kirdaar bhi ho to us ne reesmaan-e-hidaayat ko mazbooti se pakad liya hai, aur tamaam umoor ka anjaam Allah ki taraf hai

Aur jo kufr ikhtiyaar kar le us ke kufr se tum ko ranjeeda nahin hona chaahiye ke sab ki baazgasht hamaari hi taraf hai, aur us waqt hum bataayenge ke unhon ne kya kiya hai. Beshak Allah dilon ke raazon ko bhi jaanta hai
Hum inhein thode din tak aaraam denge aur phir sakht-tareen azaab ki taraf kheench kar le aayenge
Aur agar aap un se sawaal karein ke zameen o aasmaan ka khaaliq kaun hai to kahenge ke Allah. To phir kahiye ke saari hamd Allah ke liye hai, aur un ki aksariyat bilkul jaahil hai
Allah hi ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki tamaam cheezein hain, aur wahi be-niyaaz bhi hai aur qaabil-e-sataaish bhi

Aur agar roo-e-zameen ke tamaam darakht qalam ban jaayein aur samandar ka sahaara dene ke liye saat samandar aur aa jaayein to bhi kalimaat-e-Ilaahi tamaam hone waale nahin hain. Beshak Allah saahib-e-izzat bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai
Tum sab ki khilqat aur tum sab ka dobaara zinda karna sab ek hi aadmi jaisa hai, aur Allah yaqeenan sab kuch sunne waala aur dekhne waala hai

Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke Khuda hi raat ko din mein aur din ko raat mein daakhil karta hai, aur us ne chaand aur sooraj ko musakhkhar kar diya hai ke sab ek mu'ayyan muddat tak chalte rahenge, aur Allah tumhaare tamaam aamaal se baakhabar hai
Yeh sab isi liye hai ke Khuda ma'bood-e-barhaq hai, aur us ke ilaawa jis ko bhi yeh log pukaarte hain woh sab baatil hain, aur Allah buland o baala aur buzurg o bartar hai

Kya tum ne nahin dekha ke ne'mat-e-Khuda hi se kashtiyaan darya mein chal rahi hain taake woh tumhein apni nishaaniyaan dikhlaaye, ke is mein tamaam sabr o shukr karne waalon ke liye badi nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain

Aur jab saaebaanon ki tarah koi mauj inhein dhaankne lagti hai to deen ke poore ikhlaas ke saath Khuda ko aawaaz dete hain, aur jab woh najaat de kar khushki tak pahuncha deta hai to un mein se kuch hi e'tidaal par reh jaate hain, aur hamaari aayaat ka inkaar ghaddaar aur naashukre afraad ke ilaawa koi nahin karta hai

Insaano! Apne Parwardigar se daro aur us din se daro jis din na baap bete ke kaam aaega aur na beta baap ke kuch kaam aa sakega. Beshak Allah ka waada barhaq hai, lihaaza tumhein zindagaani-e-duniya dhoke mein na daal de, aur khabardaar koi dhoka dene waala bhi tumhein dhoka na de sake

Yaqeenan Allah hi ke paas qiyaamat ka ilm hai, aur wahi paani barsaata hai aur shikam ke andar ka haal jaanta hai, aur koi nafs yeh nahin jaanta hai ke woh kal kya kamaaega, aur kisi ko nahin maaloom hai ke use kis zameen par maut aaegi. Beshak Allah jaanne waala aur baakhabar hai
